description: A RANKED LIST OF CRYPTOS of a chosen size: a count (1-20), an optional minimum Startingale and an optional sector. Those are its only filters; a venue, a round count and a minimum Martingale Score are filters of search_instruments. crypto_overview returns a fixed top 5 with no arguments. Answers in formatted text. Costs 3 units of the monthly quota.

limit.description: How many to return, highest Martingale Score first. 1-20, default 10.

min_startingale.description: Keep only cryptos at or above this Startingale reading: how well the CURRENT price sits versus the structure, unlike the Martingale Score which ranks them. Scale 0-5: 4.3 and above reads Strong, 3.7 and above Favorable, 3 and above Moderate, below that Misaligned. Default: 0 (no filter).

sector.description: Keep only cryptos in this sector (source: Tradingale): exact label, case-insensitive, one of: Layer 1, Layer 2, DeFi, Artificial Intelligence, Meme, Real World Assets, Privacy, Payments, DePIN & Storage, Gaming & Metaverse, Exchange Tokens, Infrastructure, Other. Without it, every sector.
